observations.behavior: Adds a new Kea logic module, runSlashCommandsLogic, that parses slash commands and dispatches actions for predefined commands like /usage, /good, /bad, /feedback, /ticket, and /btw. It also formats usage summaries and captures analytics events.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a command-dispatch layer for PostHog AI agent runs, allowing users to invoke predefined commands without sending them to the agent. This could support command-specific workflows and analytics. No score assigned.
